races.name: Salomon Vitosha Trail 12 km
races.summary: Recorded 12.74 km from Aleko, over the south ridge to Cherni Vrah and back. Closest trail point to Kumata is 12.0 km, just before the finish.

aid_stations.name: Cherni Vrah
aid_stations.notes: Summit. The track passes 3 m from the peak. Water only.

aid_stations.name: Konyarnika / Kumata
aid_stations.notes: Closest point on this track to Kumata, 0.7 km before the finish.

races.name: Salomon Vitosha Trail 27 km
races.summary: Recorded 26.80 km from Aleko: Cherni Vrah, the Zlatni Mostove plateau, then the Boyana trail back to Aleko.

aid_stations.name: Cherni Vrah
aid_stations.notes: Summit. Snapped to the track point 3 m from the peak.

aid_stations.name: Zlatni Mostove
aid_stations.notes: Plateau above the Golden Bridges. The pin is 2 m from the aid waypoint.

aid_stations.name: Momina Skala / Boyana trail
aid_stations.notes: High trail toward Boyana. Snapped onto the track, not down in the village.

races.name: Salomon Vitosha Trail 40 km
races.summary: Recorded 40.14 km from Aleko, out to the southeast valley, over Cherni Vrah, then Zlatni Mostove and the Boyana trail.

aid_stations.name: Kamen Del / Cherni Vrah
aid_stations.notes: Summit aid. The track point is 1 m from the Cherni Vrah waypoint. Kamen Del's ridge control is 1.5 km earlier.

aid_stations.name: Zlatni Mostove
aid_stations.notes: Plateau above the Golden Bridges, on the recorded aid waypoint.

aid_stations.name: Boyana
aid_stations.notes: Boyana trail aid. Snapped 2 m onto the track.

races.name: Vitosha 100 km
races.summary: Recorded 100.40 km loop from Boyana around the foot of Vitosha. Aid stations sit on the track about 8–12 km apart.

aid_stations.name: Tikhiyat Kat
aid_stations.notes: Water and light food. Snapped onto the track at 9.5 km.

aid_stations.name: Vladaya
aid_stations.notes: Water and food. Snapped onto the track at 15.5 km.

aid_stations.name: Kladnitsa
aid_stations.notes: Water and food. Snapped onto the track at 23.5 km.

aid_stations.name: Studena
aid_stations.notes: Water and food. Snapped onto the track at 29.0 km.

aid_stations.name: Chuypetlovo
aid_stations.notes: Water, hot food, and a drop bag. Snapped onto the track at 41.5 km.

aid_stations.name: Yarlovo
aid_stations.notes: Water and food. Snapped onto the track at 52.5 km.

aid_stations.name: Breze / Bukovets
aid_stations.notes: Water and food. Snapped onto the track at 63.0 km.

aid_stations.name: Bistritsa / Zheleznitsa
aid_stations.notes: Water and food. Snapped onto the track at 75.5 km.

aid_stations.name: Simeonovo / Dragalevtsi
aid_stations.notes: Water and food. Snapped onto the track at 88.5 km.

aid_stations.name: Finish (Boyana)
aid_stations.notes: Finish pin on the track at 100.0 km. The recorded course ends 0.4 km later.
